_comment: Fallback demo registry. The live one lives in the site_settings table under
the key 'demos' and is edited at /admin/demos.html — that is what lets you
flip 'purchased' without a deploy. This file is only used when that row is
missing or unreachable, so keep it roughly in step but do not rely on it.
Paths are relative to the site root. The demo's own URL is derived as
demos/{niche}/{slug}/, so it is not stored twice.
purchased  true once they have paid. Shows the verified badge in the library
and, if live_url is set, the 'this website is live' bar on the demo.
live_url   the client's real website. Only used when purchased is true.

demos.name: Showroom Reflections
demos.tagline: High-end mobile auto detailing and ceramic coating.
